title: Agent Handoff Configuration
description: Schema for handoff.config.json — where handoffs are stored, and how a session is captured. Copy handoff.config.example.json to your project root as handoff.config.json to opt in; with no config file the engine keeps its default store. HANDOFFS_ROOT always overrides anything set here.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor completion.

handoff_dir.description: Where handoffs are stored. Relative paths resolve against the directory holding this file; absolute paths are used as-is.

project_name.description: Project used for grouping handoffs. Auto-detected when null.

auto_capture.description: Accepted and validated; reserved — no tool auto-captures sessions yet.

max_brief_tokens.description: Accepted and validated; reserved — brief truncation is not implemented.

exclude_from_handoff.description: Accepted and validated; reserved — the engine copies no project trees, so nothing is filtered yet.

enabled.description: HONOURED: when false, cross-project link notes are not written.

min_overlap_score.description: Accepted and validated; reserved — the engine uses its built-in 0.06 threshold.

type.description: Only filesystem is implemented; sqlite validates but is not honoured.

path.description: HONOURED and beats handoff_dir: an explicit store path.
